actions.action: Rotate SSH credentials — generate new key pair: ssh-keygen -t ed25519
Move to key-based SSH auth — disable password auth in sshd_config
Generate new Django SECRET_KEY — python -c 'from django.core.management.utils import get_random_secret_key; print(get_random_secret_key())'
Rotate SMTP/email password — log into email provider and generate new authorization code
Update ALL production environment variables outside repo — never in .env committed to git
Review server login logs — /var/log/auth.log, last command
Confirm full backup before any deployment — database + media + config
Do NOT paste new secrets into Codex or any AI tool
